tasks.short: Perform executive protection and assess the risks

steps.what: Perform executive protection activities in person
Assess security risks after the movement

tasks.design: The day's movement brief is opened from {DOCS}. Performing executive protection stays in person. The security manager assesses security risks after the movement. A brief is not a protection plan, and it is not sent onward by itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: Movements arrived by message, and the risk note was written from memory.
tasks.enabler_now: A brief can be opened with the date.
tasks.still_hard: Protection, and the assessment of risk, stay with the person who was there.
tasks.human_edge: The manager sees a risk the brief did not name.
tasks.altitude: The brief is in one place. The protection and the risk note stay in person.

reach.learn: Which risk was added after the movement

evidence.claim: The source pack says security work in this group is ticket and incident-log configuration, and that the judgement stays with a person. A movement brief does not perform protection.

assumptions: The work starts when a movement is booked and ends when the manager assesses the risks.
A brief has a person id, a time, and a place, produced by the principal's office. A missing place is not filled in.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the security manager's effort.
A draft that cites an identifier which is not in the store is discarded.
The incremental hours retire stale drafts when source rows change.
unknowns: Whether movement briefs are stored or only messaged.
research_questions: Who may read a risk note about a named principal?

already_counted.description: Protection time is already in the protection step.

incremental.description: Amend a risk note if the movement changes.

approvals.approved_version: risk note the manager assessed for that movement

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving falls when the brief is a message. Protection stays in person. The range is below that case.

tasks.short: Review security operations from financial reports

steps.what: Build financial reports from posted lines
Draft an efficiency note from the report

loop.purpose: Draft an efficiency note that cites only posted cost lines.
loop.input: Cost line id, amount, and period.
loop.output: Note lines that each cite a cost line id.
loop.check: Every figure cites a stored line, and no quality judgement is added.
loop.stop: Stop when the period has no lines.
loop.why_not_simpler: A commentary template cannot show which line a figure came from.

tasks.design: Financial reports are built from posted lines on {BI}. An efficiency note cites only those lines. The security manager reviews the quality of security operations, and that review is what is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same lines were copied into a commentary each month.
tasks.enabler_now: Posted lines can be reported for a period.
tasks.still_hard: Whether operations were efficient or of good quality stays a review.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows a line that does not describe the operation.

ambition.what: A posting change can refresh the note the same week, and an unchecked figure is not filed.

tasks.altitude: The week is the quality review, not the rebuild of the report.

evidence.claim: A note that cites posted cost lines can be checked. The source pack says security work in this group is ticket and incident-log configuration, and that the judgement stays with a person. Quality is still a review. The source pack's finance note is commentary on queried figures, not a decision.

assumptions: The work starts when the finance period closes and ends when the manager files the review.
A cost line has an id, an amount, and a period, produced by the finance posting. A line that is not posted is not in the note.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the security manager's effort.
A draft that cites an identifier which is not in the store is discarded.
The incremental hours retire stale drafts when source rows change.
unknowns: Whether security costs are posted as their own lines.
research_questions: What this firm means by efficiency of security operations?

already_counted.description: The quality review is already in the review step.

incremental.description: Retire a review when a posted amount changes.

approvals.approved_version: review the manager made for that period

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving falls when costs are not posted. The quality review stays. The range is below that case.

tasks.short: Conduct reviews and assess security effectiveness

steps.what: Assemble process records the review requested
Conduct governmental reviews of facility processes
Write assessments of personnel security effectiveness

tasks.design: Process records a review requested are assembled from {DOCS} and the {OPS_SYSTEM}. Conducting governmental reviews of facility processes stays in person. Assessments of personnel security effectiveness are written by the security manager. A record pack is not an assessment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reviewers were handed a pile of files with no index of what was asked.
tasks.enabler_now: Requested records can be assembled by id.
tasks.still_hard: The review, and the assessment of effectiveness, stay with the people in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows a process the requested list missed.
tasks.altitude: The pack matches the request. The review and the assessment stay in person.

evidence.claim: The source pack says security work in this group is ticket and incident-log configuration, and that the judgement stays with a person. Assembling records is not the review.

The source pack names a rule that a significant decision about a person is not taken by automation alone, and that hiring, appraisal, or staff monitoring needs works-council consent. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a governmental or internal review is opened and ends when the manager writes the assessment.
A process record has an id and a text, produced by operations. The pack includes only ids the review named. Personnel effectiveness is written by the manager and is not a score.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the security manager's effort.
A draft that cites an identifier which is not in the store is discarded.
The incremental hours retire stale drafts when source rows change.
unknowns: Whether process records have ids a review can name.
research_questions: Who receives an assessment that discusses named people?

already_counted.description: The review itself is already in the conduct step.

incremental.description: Amend an assessment if a requested record is replaced.

approvals.approved_version: assessment the manager wrote for that review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving falls when records have no ids. The review stays in person. No score is produced. The range is below that case.

tasks.short: Support workplace efforts without an accusation

steps.what: List support routes and open concerns
Support efforts on substance abuse in person
Record the workplace action that was taken

tasks.design: Support routes and open concerns are listed from {DOCS}. Supporting efforts on substance abuse or other illegal activity stays in person. The security manager writes the workplace action. A model does not accuse anyone, and the list is not a finding.
tasks.previous_blocker: Routes were known to a few people, and notes were inconsistent.
tasks.enabler_now: A route can be listed, and a concern can be logged without a conclusion.
tasks.still_hard: Support, and any action, stay with the manager and the people involved.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows when a concern is not evidence.
tasks.altitude: Routes are listed. The support and the action note stay with the manager, and nothing is inferred from the list.

reach.learn: What was not treated as illegal activity

evidence.claim: Listing a support route is configuration. The source pack says security work in this group is ticket and incident-log configuration, and that the judgement stays with a person. It does not establish substance abuse or illegal activity.

The source pack names a rule that a significant decision about a person is not taken by automation alone, and that hiring, appraisal, or staff monitoring needs works-council consent. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a workplace concern is raised and ends when the manager files the action note.
A route has an id and a contact. A concern has an id and a date, produced by the person who logged it. The draft step does not exist: no text about a person is generated.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the security manager's effort.
A draft that cites an identifier which is not in the store is discarded.
The incremental hours retire stale drafts when source rows change.
unknowns: Which concerns may be stored, and who may read them.
research_questions: When must a concern go to people management or to an authority?

already_counted.description: Support time is already in the support step.

incremental.description: Withdraw a note if the concern was mistaken.

approvals.approved_version: action note the manager wrote for that concern

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving falls when routes are not written down. No accusation is generated. The range is below that case.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Executive protection stays in person. Financial notes cite posted lines, and quality is a review. Governmental reviews are conducted, not generated. Substance-abuse support is not an accusation.
reach: Finance sees the filed review, not an unchecked figure.
People management sees the action the manager wrote.
skills_to_grow: Do not fill a movement the brief left blank.
Do not generate a finding about a person.
role.ambitious_version: A posting change refreshes the efficiency note the same week, and the old figure does not stay in the review.
